scope: finite numerical diagnostic only; no Cn theorem
precision: closed form 160 decimal; independent direct quadrature and finite differences 256 decimal (>512 bits)
crosscheck: per chunk two h values at rho/r=2^256 and epsilon factor1/2: four points around kink and boundary, one-sided differences step 2^-240; baseline target mean and second moment at R=r
diagnostic_bound: abs(rho*d_q Jphi)<=8, pointwise/a.e. with two one-sided values at kink
independent_tolerance: rho*Jphi difference <1e-80; derivative difference <1e-25; scaled baseline mean diff <1e-100
stop: finite task counts; on first exception or candidate violation preserve parameters, stop affected chunk
